mentions.h: EVENT ROUND UP OF INDIVIDUAL PERFORMANCES

photos.c: RIGHT.Probably BELGRAVES youngest ever team L. to R.Teddy Davis(8yr),Adrian Ross(10yr),Toby Stride(10yr)who competed in this year's Collingwood cross country races.

Adrian Ross rounded off a fine season, which saw him capture the Berkshire County Boys 400m and 800m titles and the Berkshire Schools 800m, by running the remarkable time of 2.03.79 in a Boys Invitation 800m at Crystal Palace on 14 September. This mark constitutes a club record and finally removes a number of venerable 880 yards performances from the books.
